To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NPLC-GCMS method allows for the determination of 72 PAHS and 56 Me-PAHs, and for tentative identification of 148 compounds.
a normal-phase liquid chromatographic fractionation procedure can be used to separate a complex mixture of PAHs and MePAHs from a coal tar.

the normal-phase liquid chromatographic separation of a complex mixture, coal tar, followed by gas chromatography/mas spectrometry with a 50 percent phenyl column, allowed the identification of 128 polycyclic aromatic compounds, 72 polycyclic aromatic hydrides (PAHs), and 56 methyl-substituted polycyclic aromatic hydrides (MePAHs).
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing and applying a NPLC fractioning procedure and GC/MS analysis to characterize the PAHs and MePAHs from SRM 1596.

the development of a NPLC fraction method for the characterization of complex mixtures of PAHs and MePAHs from coal tar samples, and the application of this NPLC fraction procedure for the characterization of SRM coal tar 1597a.
the development of an analytical procedure for the qualitative characterization of SRMs for PAHs and MePAHs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NPLC-GCMS method presented in this work is a valuable tool for the characterization of coal tar samples.
the NPLC-GCxMS method described in this study provides an excellent method for the characterization of complex PAH and MePAH mixtures.
NPLC fractionated SRM 1596a is a complex mixture of PAHs and MePAHs, and the NPLC fractionations are a useful tool for the identification of individual components in complex mixtures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
242 PAHs and MePAHs were identified in SRM 159 7a.
the NPLC fraction method was effective in separating the PAHs from the coal tar sample and allowed for the identification and tentative identification of a large number of PAHs and MePAHs by GC/MS.
the NPLC-GCMS method is an excellent tool to characterize complex mixtures of PAHs and MePAHs in coal tar samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NPLC fractionated coal tar is a valuable sample for PAH and MePAH characterization.
NPLC fractionations can be used to simplify a complex PAH mixture for subsequent GC/MS analyses.
NPLC fractionated SRM 1595a can be used for the identification of a wide variety of PAHs and MePAHs by GC/MS.
